slides.title: Squat. Stop. Press.
slides.body: You stand up, the bar parks on your shoulders, then your arms start a whole new lift.

slides.title: Your arms do the legs' job.
slides.body: The stop kills the drive from your hips. Now your shoulders press the full weight, every rep, for 21 reps.

slides.title: Press while you stand.
slides.body: Drive hard out of the bottom and start pushing as your hips open. Legs launch it, arms just finish it.

slides.title: Elbows up at the bottom.
slides.body: Bar on your shoulders, not in your hands. Elbows drop and the bar rolls forward before you even stand.

slides.title: Breathe at the top.
slides.body: Lockout is your only rest. Exhale overhead, quick breath on the way down, brace, go.
